title: French Crispy Cheese Casserole
description: A rich and creamy French casserole recipe, featuring crispy cheese on top, sure to delight.
instructions: Cook the cubed baguette until lightly toasted.
In a separate pan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the flour and whisk until a smooth paste forms.
Slowly add the shredded cheese, stirring constantly until melted and smooth.
Add the cooked baguette, crispy bacon, and salt and pepper to taste.
Pour the cheese mixture into a pre-made casserole.
Top with additional shredded cheese and crispy bacon.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly.
